rationale: Round 1 kept Haiku 4-5 at quality 0.925 (summary_quality 0.85) and latency 25772ms (median). The frontier is quality=0.95 (Sonnet) and latency=25772 (Haiku). To extend the latency frontier past the 2000ms epsilon we need the median-position PDF to run on a model meaningfully faster than Haiku, which means moving the small/medium PDFs to GPT-luna. GPT-5-6-luna (the mid-tier GPT option: 5x cheaper than Haiku, less risky than GPT-6-luna's 10x bet) is the right first probe. The write_agent step installs a tiny size-based router that keeps the 4 largest, most structurally complex rules on Sonnet 4-6 for quality insurance. Thresholds and models are chosen for clean attribution: a later round can tighten the byte threshold or shift the fallback to Haiku once we have a measured quality number for GPT-5-6-luna. No clash with existing scaffold rules/skills (no sampling or prompt changes).
